Here's some debug output from that linking code:

```
symbol conflict: '__constant_4xi8'
target op:
vm.rodata @__constant_4xi8 dense<[0, 0, 0, 1]> : tensor<4xi8>
  (visibility public)
source op:
vm.rodata @__constant_4xi8 dense<[0, 0, 1, 0]> : tensor<4xi8>
  (visibility public)
ops are *not* equivalent, need to disambiguate
```

Relating this back to [the comment thread there](https://github.com/google/iree/issues/4897#issuecomment-800803557), could these `vm.rodata` ops be marked private ([Symbol Visibility docs](https://mlir.llvm.org/docs/SymbolsAndSymbolTables/#symbol-visibility))? I'm trying to decide how to resolve that conflict and it would be safer to only rename private symbols while merging modules.

We have other private `RodataOp`s, like https://github.com/google/iree/blob/53b850448b371d4d828091c7617d2b51bdb5d8f2/iree/compiler/Dialect/HAL/Conversion/HALToVM/ConvertExecutableOps.cpp#L77-L84

What code is producing those in this case?
RE visibility: rodata should all be private so it's worth setPrivate()ing everywhere.

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
During the LinkExecutables pass for vmvx, duplicately named tensors are overridden to a single value. 

**To Reproduce**
Download the attached file and execute below:

`iree-opt /tmp/test.mlir.txt --split-input-file --iree-hal-link-executables --iree-hal-target-backends vmvx`

vm.rodata for both functions will result in being the same

**Additional context**
[test.mlir.txt](https://github.com/google/iree/files/6504932/test.mlir.txt)

issue.body:
Executable linking merges multiple modules together into a single module. If a symbol name already exists in the merged module, we previously skipped over it assuming the contents of those symbols were identical. This now resolve conflicts by
* renaming different private symbols
* merging equivalent private symbols
* emitting an error for public symbol conflicts

Fixes https://github.com/google/iree/issues/5946.
Includes a step towards https://github.com/google/iree/issues/4670 that should be made generic in some way.
Issues like https://github.com/google/iree/issues/4897 will still need to use MLIR symbol visibility (not some special visibility) or ensure uniqueness prior to this pass.
